import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('don_hang.csv')
df['Ngày'] = pd.to_datetime(df['Ngày'])

# January 2026: all orders placed (all statuses)
mask = (df['Ngày'] >= '2026-01-01') & (df['Ngày'] <= '2026-01-31')
jan = df[mask]
total = len(jan)
cancelled = len(jan[jan['Tình trạng'] == 'cancelled'])
print("total orders Jan 2026:", total)
print("status counts:")
print(jan['Tình trạng'].value_counts())
print("cancelled:", cancelled)
rate = cancelled / total * 100
print("rate:", rate)
print("rounded 2dp:", round(rate, 2))
